title: YinYang-Align: Benchmarking Contradictory Objectives and Proposing Multi-Objective Optimization based DPO for Text-to-Image Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using Simulated Cultural Context Matching (SCCM), which dynamically generates culturally specific sub-prompts using LLMs and compares their CLIP embeddings with the generated image to measure cultural accuracy, diversity, and the presence of stereotyping.

Evaluated using an Emotional Impact Score (EIS) and a Neutrality Score, which utilize pretrained emotion detection models (e.g., DeepEmotion) to measure the degree of emotional dominance versus impartial, unbiased representation in the generated images.

Evaluated qualitatively as a sub-component of the Cultural Sensitivity objective by inspecting generated images for gender balance and ethnic diversity (e.g., analyzing demographic variations in prompts like 'Images of Vikings').
